title: Great App, Just Needs Some Refinement
body: Streaking is a great app to track your habits, though the user interface can be clunky and unpolished at times. The menu can be slightly inconvenient to navigate, while the social feature needs some love. This app is great in concept and I’ll continue to use it. I just hope the mechanics of the app improves over time. Keep up the good work!
author: Kiwqii
